client_secret.description: Client secret to authenticate with. Returned on create and by `deployment.credential.secret.read`, which reads it from the realm rather than from us -- Phase Two keeps no copy. Reading does not rotate it, so prefer fetching it when needed over storing it.

name.description: Name this credential was created with, echoed back from the client ID.

description.description: Free-text note recorded on the client, to tell credentials apart.

roles.description: `realm-management` roles granted to this credential. On create this is what was actually granted, which is worth checking against what you asked for.

server_url.description: Base URL of the deployment's Keycloak instance.
